why: The sign-in form's Show button sits inside the password field at its right end by design (JON-513): the field keeps 78 px of padding on its right for it (the button is 64 px wide, 5 px from the edge), so nothing typed is ever under it. Seen once v0.31.4 (the layout sweep) met v0.31.3's sign-in help.

A Code session's title in the Projects list is its first prompt; a long one is cut with an ellipsis and its full text in the row's tooltip. The real fix is short, readable session titles (UX audit E10, JON-517); remove this entry with that change.
